verdict.rationale: BugSnag docs mention giving customers control over which events count toward their event quota (bugsnag-docs-14), and community pricing discussion confirms plan-based event caps exist (bugsnag-comm-3, bugsnag-comm-4), but there is no explicit documentation of setting a spend cap or hard budget limit to prevent overage billing. missing for 10: explicit spend-limit/budget-cap feature documentation, engineering-leader-facing quota configuration UI, confirmation that exceeding quota does not trigger surprise charges.
